description_en: Configures the scheduler settings of a cluster
description_zh: 为指定集群设置调度器配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc set-scheduler-info --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --scheduler SchedName=pbs --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetSchedulerInfo

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html operation to obtain the IDs of regions supported by Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC)
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188593.html获取E-HPC支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The user that can use the queue. Separate multiple users with commas (`,`).

If you specify users, you must specify the PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue parameter
fields.help_zh:
限制该队列使用的用户名，多个用户用`,`隔开。

当设置了用户名时，PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue为必选
fields.name: acl_users

fields.help_en:
AclLimit specifies the queue that has limits when it is used. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

If you set `PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue` to `workq` and `PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.AclUsers` to `user1,user2`, workq can be used only by user1 and user2
fields.help_zh:
AclLimit指用户使用的队列限制。N的取值范围：0~100。

假设`PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.Queue`设置为`workq`，`PbsInfo.N.AclLimit.N.AclUsers`设置为`user1,user2`，表示队列workq只能被user1和user2使用
fields.name: queue

fields.help_en: The information about limits on the queue
fields.name: acl_limit

fields.help_en:
The retention period of jobs. After the retention period is exceeded, job data is deleted. Unit: days.\
Valid values: 1 to 30.\
Default value: 14
fields.help_zh:
作业保留时间，超过保留之间后，作业数据会被销毁。单位为天。    
取值范围：1~30。    
默认值：14
fields.name: job_history_duration

fields.help_en: The maximum number of vCPUs that can be used for nodes in a queue
fields.help_zh: 集群用户使用队列中节点的最大vCPU个数
fields.name: cpus

fields.help_en: The maximum number of jobs that can be submitted to the cluster. If the total number of running jobs and queuing jobs exceeds the value, no more jobs can be submitted
fields.help_zh: 集群用户提交的最大作业数目。若用户的运行和排队作业数目总和超过此数值则将无法再继续提交作业
fields.name: max_jobs

fields.help_en:
The maximum memory resources that can be used in a queue. Units:

gb
mb
kb
fields.help_zh:
集群用户使用队列的最大内存资源。单位取值范围：

gb

mb

kb
fields.name: mem

fields.help_en: The maximum number of nodes that can be used in a queue
fields.help_zh: 集群用户使用队列的最大节点个数
fields.name: nodes

fields.help_en:
PbsInfo specifies the number of PBS schedulers that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

ResourceLimit specifies the maximum number of queue resources that can be used. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

Queue specifies the name of the queue that is used to run jobs.

If one of the User, Cpus, Nodes, and Mem parameters is set in ResourceLimit, you must specify the Queue parameter
fields.help_zh:
PbsInfo指集群中可以设置的PBS调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

ResourceLimit指用户使用的队列资源限制。N的取值范围：0~100。

Queue指该集群用户运行作业使用的队列名称。

当ResourceLimit中设置了User、Cpus、Nodes、Mem中任一一个参数时，Queue为必选
fields.name: queue

fields.help_en: The name of the user that runs jobs
fields.help_zh: 运行作业的集群用户名
fields.name: user

fields.help_en: The information about the nodes that are used by cluster users
fields.help_zh: 集群用户使用的节点信息列表
fields.name: resource_limit

fields.help_en:
PbsInfo specifies the number of PBS schedulers that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

SchedInterval specifies the scheduling period. Unit: seconds.

A scheduling period is the interval between two consecutive running jobs. If you set SchedInterval to 60, another job can be run 60 seconds after a job starts running.

Default value: 60
fields.help_zh:
PbsInfo指集群中可以设置的PBS调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

SchedInterval指调度周期，单位：秒

调度周期指运行多个作业之间时间间隔，如设置为60，表示本次作业开始运行60秒后才能开始运行下次作业。

默认值：60
fields.name: sched_interval

fields.help_en: The maximum number of jobs that can be scheduled in the cluster. If the total number of running jobs and queuing jobs exceeds the value, no more jobs can be submitted. Default value: 20000
fields.help_zh: 集群调度的最大作业数。若集群排队和运行的作业数总和超过此数值则无法再继续提交作业。默认值：20000
fields.name: sched_max_jobs

fields.help_en: The maximum number of queuing jobs that can be scheduled in the cluster. If the number of queuing jobs exceeds the value, no more jobs can be submitted. Default value: 10000
fields.help_zh: 集群调度的最大排队作业数。若集群排队作业数量超过此数值则无法再继续提交作业。默认值：10000
fields.name: sched_max_queued_jobs

fields.help_en:
The backfill scheduling period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60
fields.help_zh:
Backfill调度周期设置，单位：秒

默认值：60
fields.name: backfill_interval

fields.help_en:
SlurmInfo specifies the number of Slurm schedulers that can be configured in the cluster. Valid values of N: 0 to 100.

SchedInterval specifies the scheduling period. Unit: seconds.

Default value: 60
fields.help_zh:
SlurmInfo指集群中可以设置的Slurm调度信息个数。N的取值范围：0~100。

SchedInterval指主调度周期设置，单位：秒

默认值：60
fields.name: sched_interval

fields.help_en:
The name of the scheduler. Valid values:

pbs
pbs19
slurm
slurm19
slurm20

If you set Scheduler.N.SchedName to pbs or pbs19, you must specify at least one of the PbsInfo.N.SchedInterval, PbsInfo.N.JobHistoryDuration, PbsInfo.N.ResourceLimit, and PbsInfo.N.AclLimit parameters. If you set Scheduler.N.SchedName to slurm, slurm19, or slurm20, you must specify at least one of the SlurmInfo.N.SchedInterval and SlurmInfo.N.BackfillInterval parameters
fields.help_zh:
调度器名，取值范围：

pbs
pbs19
slurm
slurm19
slurm20

调度器为pbs、pbs19时，PbsInfo.N.SchedInterval、PbsInfo.N.JobHistoryDuration、PbsInfo.N.ResourceLimit、PbsInfo.N.AclLimit中至少一个参数为必选；调度器为slurm、slurm19、slurm20时，SlurmInfo.N.SchedInterval、SlurmInfo.N.BackfillInterval中至少一个参数为必选
fields.name: sched_name
